name: Collector’s tin
description: Fill a tin with what you love
promptTemplate: Using a rectangular collector’s tin, fill both sides with objects that are uniquely me, using only the subject details explicitly provided for this request, and paint it with my favorite color.
promptHints: Photo of a person participating in a hobby or unique activity

exampleImages.alt: An open collector’s tin holds photographs, a camera, binoculars, flowers, paints, a pencil, and a small knitted figure against a pale green background.
